native-input-presence.decision: Preserve native input presence/defaults and existing source-reviewed call shorthands.
native-input-presence.reason: Optionality disagreements do not authorize relaxing native secret permissions or accepting opaque inputs. The selected native contract and explicit existing corrections stay authoritative for these exact positions.

native-object-omission.decision: Retain and audit the canonical native method; no TSM comparison is claimed.
native-object-omission.reason: The exact seven object families are absent from the actual archive and TSM explicitly skips APIs outside its class map.

native-positional-contract.decision: Retain the native argument/return positions and reviewed ABI corrections rather than adopt an alternative arity.
native-positional-contract.reason: Vendor and scraped fallback declarations omit/add positions, or generated zero-argument widget methods deliberately use an untyped vararg. Return-only dependent variants cannot safely choose a Teal result type. Exact facts and all alternatives remain in this ledger.

native-secret-aspects.decision: Preserve native ObjectType aspect restrictions omitted by the TSM narrowing overrides.
native-secret-aspects.reason: GetObjectType/IsObjectType special static narrowing is not permission to inspect inaccessible native identities.

native-secret-permissions.decision: Keep the native secret argument policy and scopes, never the union of alternate permissions.
native-secret-permissions.reason: TSM intentionally promotes constant-accessor/aspect-setter policies and some overrides omit policy annotations. Neither establishes permission for an addon to pass secret inputs contrary to the native contract.

native-structural-contract.decision: Retain the precise native contract and separately evidenced effective corrections; preserve every compared structural relationship.
native-structural-contract.reason: Callback handle branches, omitted callback arguments, generic class selectors, pack intersections and secret-dependent relationships are now represented explicitly. They do not justify erasing constraints, exposing secret values, or substituting the TSM resolver for the maintained Teal boundary.

native-table-count-secrecy.decision: Keep table.count secret-capable and preserve its native predicate/arity; reject TSM override declassification.
native-table-count-secrecy.reason: The native documentation marks the count secret when the input table has secret keys; the TSM table override omits this metadata and declares additional result positions.

nominal-or-refined-type.decision: Keep the canonical native carrier/interface and reviewed corrections. Do not erase nominal distinctions or adopt broader any inputs.
nominal-or-refined-type.reason: These exact remaining names are nominal record/subclass distinctions, vendor literal refinements, variant alias definitions or stale spellings. Primitive alias equivalence is normalized separately. A vendor refinement is not independent proof of a different native carrier.

preserve-native-absence.decision: Keep the possibly absent tuple in emitted types.
preserve-native-absence.reason: Native MayReturnNothing and access-precondition failure modes apply even when vendor or alternate Wiki annotations omit nilability.

primary-carrier-correction.decision: Use the source-backed corrected carrier while preserving native positions, nilability, aspects and secret permissions.
primary-carrier-correction.reason: These exact attribute/font/CVar carriers are demonstrated by build-matched Blizzard callers; the original scalar-only metadata is incomplete. Dynamic attributes remain opaque, font inputs stay string|Font, and CVar values stay public string|number, never any or secret-permissive.

primary-return-correction.decision: Retain the source-backed corrected result without inventing dependent tuple precision.
primary-return-correction.reason: Blizzard callers demonstrate the missing cursor/actor results. Cursor payloads remain opaque, actor handles canonical, and nil conservative; native inputs and secrecy rules remain unchanged.

vendor-additional-absence.decision: Preserve the native contract; retain the additional vendor nilability as an explicit upstream precision difference.
vendor-additional-absence.reason: These exact vendor annotations add absence without native absence metadata. They do not justify a new runtime availability guarantee. Existing runtime absence/accessibility checks remain required; Teal itself admits nil.

verified-native-capability-composition.decision: Use source-backed LayeredRegion composition for VectorGraphics; native lookup corroborates its exact 106-method capability set and the complete Wowless LayeredRegion+ScriptObject composition.
verified-native-capability-composition.reason: Build-matched owned native observations establish method availability despite different virtual and native type names. Existing native signatures and secret restrictions remain authoritative; presence does not certify complete inherited signatures.
